Oman Fuel Prices and Fuel Cost Calculator

Pick your fuel, tank size and monthly distance to see the cost of a full tank and your monthly fuel bill in Omani rials.

Fuel prices in Oman

ProductBaisa a litreOMR a litre
M91 petrol2290.229
M95 petrol2390.239
Diesel2580.258

These are the October 2021 prices that a Royal directive on 9 November 2021 froze as a ceiling, and they include 5% VAT. When VAT started in April 2021, M95 went from 216 to 227 baisa, exactly 5% more. We last checked the prices on 3 November 2026 and will update this page if a change is announced.

How to work out your fuel cost

Full tank = tank size × price a litre. Monthly cost = (distance a month × litres per 100 km ÷ 100) × price a litre. A car that covers 2,000 km a month at 8 litres per 100 km needs 160 litres, which is OMR 36.640 with M91, or OMR 439.680 a year.

How Oman compares

A litre of 95 costs 239 baisa in Oman, QAR 2.10 in Qatar (Qatar prices), AED 4.04 in the UAE in November 2026 (UAE prices) and SAR 2.33 in Saudi Arabia (Saudi prices).

Frequently asked questions

What are petrol prices in Oman in 2026?

M91 is 229 baisa a litre (OMR 0.229), M95 239 baisa and diesel 258 baisa, the October 2021 prices that were frozen as a ceiling.

Why don't fuel prices change in Oman?

A Royal directive on 9 November 2021 capped prices at their October 2021 level, with the government covering the difference. They have not changed since, according to the latest reports in 2026.

How much does a 60-litre tank cost in Oman?

OMR 13.740 with M91, 14.340 with M95 and 15.480 with diesel.

Do Oman fuel prices include VAT?

Yes, they include the 5% VAT in force since April 2021.
